reviews.title: Sturdy Leveling Feet That Worked Great for My Arcade Cabinet
reviews.body: I picked up these 3/8" threaded leveling feet for my arcade cabinet, and they worked out great. They feel sturdy, fit well, and made it easy to get the cabinet sitting level and solid. Installation was simple, and once they were in place, everything felt much more stable. Great little upgrade if you need adjustable feet for a table, furniture piece, or arcade cabinet.

reviews.title: Easy to install, look and work great
reviews.body: These little adjustable furniture feet work great. I used them on two chairs we had purchased at a warehouse club. The chairs were great except that they were a bit wobbly. So rather than return them, I purchased this set. I installed them and was able to level out each of the chairs. The size is perfect for what I needed and they look as if they are original equipment on the chairs. I believe these are a great value for the money.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 19, 2025
reviews.author: MD

reviews.title: Good, but need attention.
reviews.body: These should do the job. I'm replacing some very old worn out ones on my, new-to-me (very old, used) table saw. These fit the holes right, and seem like they'll be good for a while. The wood inserts are robust, the felt pads are average,  but the hard rubber feet worry me. Not sure how long they will hold on to those felt pads. I had to clean the rubber with alcohol, the scuff them up to hold the adhesive well. With little use these should last. Adjustments are super easy with 2 nuts. Overall I feel like I picked well on these.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 14, 2025
reviews.author: Psychofisherman

reviews.title: Leveled my table perfectly. Very easy to install.
reviews.body: These are perfect! I built a table and one corner was a little bit wonky. I ordered these to help me level it. It’s very simple to install as well. You just need to drill a hole, I believe it’s a half inch, insert the piece that goes into the leg and then screw the foot on. It’s adjustable after that as well. It fixed my table perfectly.

features: 【Size】Inch coarse thread,size 3/8-16,1.4"(L)*1.4"(W)*2.38"(H)-look at the second picture in the main image. Please do not purchase without determining the thread specification.

【Note】The maximum load of this product is 1320lb,recommended for large or heavy furniture with leg diameter greater than 1-1/2", such as bar table,side table,storage cabinet,chest of drawers and so on. If less than this size, there is a risk of cracking during installation.

【Function】Avoid direct contact between the furniture legs and the ground, protect the floor, tile or carpet from damage. The height of the four furniture legs can also be adjusted according to needs, the adjustment range is between 1"to 2".Contains 8 pcs furniture pads,4 pcs for use,4 pcs for replacement after dirty.

【Install】 You need to drill a hole with a diameter of 1/2" and a depth greater than 1-1/2" on the furniture leg with an electric drill, then insert the T- nut ( tightened with a hammer ) and screw in the leg levelers. If it is a metal leg, you need to weld a 3/8" threaded insert first, and then install the leveling feet.

【Service】Our company has provided services for various furniture brands for a long time, the product quality is credible. If you receive the wrong quantity or size of the product, please contact us in time to get a new or refund.
